description: Main window: the folder dialog and the file operations TauriStore uses (write-file, which also enables open and write, reaches the same picked folder as write-text-file; TauriStore uses it only with createNew, to create a new Excel or form; the capability itself does not enforce createNew), with no static scope except the machine settings file ($APPCONFIG/machine-settings.json, and mkdir of $APPCONFIG). Only the folder the user picks is reachable (added at runtime by the dialog, kept by persisted-scope). The updater may check, then download and install a signed new version (its request is the app's only network call, made in Rust, off when the user turns it off) and the app may restart after it. No shell, other network access or delete.
